node.title: Re^2: Best practices for local libraries
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
So, I might prepend a BEGIN block and push the local path to @INC. I just looked it up, here's what I did in a script some time before: ...

I'd suggest using the [doc://lib] pragma (which [doc://unshift]s instead of [doc://push]ing) in combination with [doc://FindBin] instead; [doc://$0] can in some cases be unreliable, and the code is shorter. So if there are .pm files in the same path as the script: use FindBin; use lib $FindBin::Bin;.

Finally, into some scripts I copied every module needed, also cpan modules, getting a huge single script.

See [mod://fatpack] and [mod://pp], although with some modules they have issues.
